description: This file contains unit tests for the onboarding flow logic in an Android application, specifically testing whether the onboarding process can finish based on connection states.

classes.name: OnboardingFlowLogicTest
classes.description: Test class for onboarding flow logic, verifying conditions to complete onboarding based on connection status.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyOperatorIsConnected
methods.description: Test case to verify onboarding cannot finish when only the operator is connected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenDisconnected
methods.description: Test case to verify onboarding cannot finish when both operator and node are disconnected.

methods.name: blocksFinishWhenOnlyNodeIsConnected
methods.description: Test case to verify onboarding cannot finish when only the node is connected.

methods.name: allowsFinishOnlyWhenOperatorAndNodeAreConnected
methods.description: Test case to verify onboarding can finish only when both operator and node are connected.
